CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._field_visible(_scope text, _is_friend_tier boolean, _is_owner_tier boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE COALESCE(NULLIF(_scope,''), 'public')
    WHEN 'public'  THEN true

    WHEN 'only_me' THEN _is_owner_tier
    ELSE true

FN|admin_list_certificates(_query text,:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_certificates(_query text DEFAULT ''::text, _type text DEFAULT NULL::text, _limit integer DEFAULT 100, _offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, user_id uuid, title text, description text, type text, heading text, issued_at timestamp with time zone, is_revoked boolean, revoked_at timestamp with time zone, revoked_reason text, certificate_id text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_limit  integer := least(greatest(coalesce(_limit, 100), 1), 200);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(_offset, 0), 0);
  v_q      text    := trim(coalesce(_query, ''));
begin
  if not public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') then
    raise exception 'Not authorized';
  end if;

  return query
  with matched as (
    select c.id, c.user_id, c.title, c.description, c.type, c.heading, c.issued_at,
           c.is_revoked, c.revoked_at, c.revoked_reason, c.certificate_id::text
    from public.certificates c
    where (v_q = '' or c.title ilike '%' || v_q || '%')
      and (_type is null or _type = '' or c.type = _type)
  )
  select m.id, m.user_id, m.title, m.description, m.type, m.heading, m.issued_at,
         m.is_revoked, m.revoked_at, m.revoked_reason, m.certificate_id,
         count(*) over () as total_count
  from matched m
  order by m.issued_at desc, m.id desc
  limit v_limit offset v_offset;
end;
$function$
FN|admin_search_certificate_recipients(_:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_certificate_recipients(_query text, _limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, email text, avatar_url text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
declare
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(_limit, 20), 1), 50);
  v_q     text    := trim(coalesce(_query, ''));
begin
  if not public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') then
    raise exception 'Not authorized';
  end if;

  if v_q = '' then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  with matched as (
    select p.id, p.full_name, au.email::text as email, p.avatar_url
    from public.profiles p
    left join auth.users au on au.id = p.id
    where p.full_name ilike '%' || v_q || '%'
       or au.email    ilike '%' || v_q || '%'
  )
  select m.id, m.full_name, m.email, m.avatar_url,
         count(*) over () as total_count
  from matched m
  order by m.full_name nulls last, m.id
  limit v_limit;
end;
$function$
FN|admin_search_users_v2(_query text, _b:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_users_v2(_query text DEFAULT ''::text, _by text DEFAULT 'name'::text, _role text DEFAULT NULL::text, _badge text DEFAULT NULL::text, _limit integer DEFAULT 100, _offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, email text, full_name text, avatar_url text, bio text, is_suspended boolean, suspended_until timestamp with time zone, suspension_reason text, created_at timestamp with time zone, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_limit  integer := least(greatest(coalesce(_limit, 100), 1), 200);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(_offset, 0), 0);
  v_query  text    := coalesce(_query, '');
begin
  if not public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') then
    raise exception 'Not authorized';
  end if;

  return query
  with matched as (
    select
      p.id,
      au.email::text as email,
      p.full_name,
      p.avatar_url,
      p.bio,
      p.is_suspended,
      p.suspended_until,
      p.suspension_reason,
      p.created_at
    from public.profiles p
    left join auth.users au on au.id = p.id
    where
      (
        v_query = ''
        or (_by = 'email' and au.email ilike '%' || v_query || '%')
        or (_by <> 'email' and p.full_name ilike '%' || v_query || '%')
      )
      and (
        _role is null or _role = ''
        or exists (
          select 1 from public.user_roles ur
          where ur.user_id = p.id and ur.role = _role
        )
      )
      and (
        _badge is null or _badge = ''
        or exists (
          select 1 from public.user_badges ub
          where ub.user_id = p.id and ub.badge_type = _badge
        )
      )
  )
  select
    m.id,
    m.email,
    m.full_name,
    m.avatar_url,
    m.bio,
    m.is_suspended,
    m.suspended_until,
    m.suspension_reason,
    m.created_at,
    count(*) over () as total_count
  from matched m
  order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc
  limit v_limit offset v_offset;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_follow_official()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _official uuid := public.get_primary_admin_user_id();
BEGIN
  IF _official IS NULL OR NEW.id = _official THEN
    RETURN NEW;  -- no official set, or the official account itself
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.follows (follower_id, following_id)
  VALUES (NEW.id, _official)
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;

AS $function$

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _hit text;
BEGIN
  _hit := public._flag_review_keyword_hit(NEW.content);
  IF _hit IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(NEW.is_flagged, false) THEN
    UPDATE public.image_comments
       SET is_flagged = true,
           flag_reason = COALESCE(flag_reason, 'Auto-flagged: matched review keyword')
     WHERE id = NEW.id;

  RETURN NULL;  -- AFTER trigger

FN|get_course_lessons_for_editor(_course:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_course_lessons_for_editor(_course_id uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF lessons
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.courses c
    WHERE c.id = _course_id
      AND (c.author_id = v_uid
           OR public.has_role(v_uid, 'admin'::app_role))
           -- live app_role enum has no 'super_admin'; 'admin' is the elevated role
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized to edit this course' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT * FROM public.lessons l
    WHERE l.course_id = _course_id
    ORDER BY l.sort_order;
END;
$function$

FN|guard_profile_moderation_columns():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_profile_moderation_columns()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Only act when a moderation column actually changes
  IF NEW.is_banned IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_banned
     OR NEW.is_suspended IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_suspended
     OR NEW.suspended_until IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.suspended_until THEN

    -- Trusted actors may change anything: service_role (auth.uid() IS NULL) or an admin
    IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    -- Non-admin acting on a row (RLS already limits them to their own):
    -- (a) may NEVER change the ban flag
    IF NEW.is_banned IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_banned THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not permitted to change ban status' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

    -- (b) may only CLEAR an already-expired suspension (matches app auto-expiry)
    IF NEW.is_suspended IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_suspended
       OR NEW.suspended_until IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.suspended_until THEN
      IF NOT (OLD.is_suspended = true
              AND OLD.suspended_until IS NOT NULL
              AND OLD.suspended_until < now()
              AND NEW.is_suspended = false) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not permitted to change suspension status' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

FN|increment_managed_page_view(_page_id:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_managed_page_view(_page_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.site_settings
  SET value = (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(
          CASE WHEN (elem->>'id') = _page_id
            THEN jsonb_set(elem, '{view_count}',
                           to_jsonb(COALESCE((elem->>'view_count')::int, 0) + 1))
            ELSE elem
          END
        )
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(value) elem
      ),
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE key = 'managed_pages'
    AND jsonb_typeof(value) = 'array';
END;

FN|maintain_competition_entry_counts():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.maintain_competition_entry_counts()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if (tg_op = 'INSERT') then
    insert into public.competition_entry_counts (competition_id, status, cnt)
      values (new.competition_id, new.status, 1)
      on conflict (competition_id, status)
      do update set cnt = competition_entry_counts.cnt + 1, updated_at = now();
  elsif (tg_op = 'DELETE') then
    update public.competition_entry_counts
      set cnt = greatest(cnt - 1, 0), updated_at = now()
      where competition_id = old.competition_id and status = old.status;
  elsif (tg_op = 'UPDATE') then
    if (new.competition_id is distinct from old.competition_id)
       or (new.status is distinct from old.status) then
      update public.competition_entry_counts
        set cnt = greatest(cnt - 1, 0), updated_at = now()
        where competition_id = old.competition_id and status = old.status;
      insert into public.competition_entry_counts (competition_id, status, cnt)
        values (new.competition_id, new.status, 1)
        on conflict (competition_id, status)
        do update set cnt = competition_entry_counts.cnt + 1, updated_at = now();
    end if;
  end if;
  return null;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _post_id uuid := (_msg->>'post_id')::uuid;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.posts p SET
    likes_count    = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.post_reactions r WHERE r.post_id = p.id),
    comments_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.post_comments  c WHERE c.post_id = p.id),
    shares_count   = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.post_shares    s WHERE s.post_id = p.id)
  WHERE p.id = _post_id;
END;
